en: Those stones were old when my grandfather was young. Some say they were stood there to mark the end of a war.
text: Pietrele alea erau vechi când bunicul meu era tânăr. Unii zic că au fost ridicate să marcheze sfârșitul unui război.

en: The road east goes along the hills and up to Shalour City, where the tower is. You can see it from the sea!
text: Drumul spre est merge de-a lungul dealurilor și urcă până la Shalour City, unde e turnul. Se vede de pe mare!

en:
Geosenge Town
A quiet town beside the standing stones.
text:
Geosenge Town
Un oraș liniștit lângă pietrele ridicate.
